name: diagram-design
description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Qoder, and Pi. 52 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
one_liner: A skill that makes an AI assistant draw clean, magazine-quality diagrams instead of the ugly, generic boxes-and-arrows charts most tools spit out.
buyer: A content agency or blog writer who publishes technical explainers and needs good-looking diagrams fast without hiring a designer each time.
business_use_cases: A content agency offers 'custom diagram illustration' as a paid add-on to blog or newsletter writing packages.
A startup's marketing team uses it to make its pitch deck and landing page diagrams look professionally designed in-house.
A freelance technical writer bundles diagram creation into existing documentation contracts at a higher day rate.

money_ideas.idea: Per-diagram or per-project freelance fee added to existing content/documentation work
A monthly 'diagram design on demand' retainer for content teams

steal_this: Rebuild five diagrams from a well-known blog post using this skill this weekend, post the before/after, and use it to land your first paid diagram client.
